about: Who may hold each federal seat the federal day plays, read by the custom start (dev mode) before it seats a person. Citizenship and residence are not checked: the game's people are residents of the place they live in.

us-house.citation: U.S. Const. art. I, sec. 2, cl. 2

us-house-delegate.citation: 2 U.S.C. sec. 25a(b) (Delegate from D.C.); 48 U.S.C. secs. 1712, 1732, 1752 (the territories' delegates); 48 U.S.C. sec. 892 (Resident Commissioner, 25 years)

us-senate.citation: U.S. Const. art. I, sec. 3, cl. 3

president.citation: U.S. Const. art. II, sec. 1, cl. 5

vice-president.citation: U.S. Const. amend. XII (no one ineligible to be President may be Vice President)
